description: A hypertrophic form of lichen planus characterised by thick, intensely pruritic plaques or nodules.

appearance.general: Thick hyperkeratotic or verrucous plaques, commonly on the shins or other extremities.

warning_signs: Persistent ulceration, bleeding, marked pain, or a lesion that changes should be assessed to exclude malignancy.
doctor_discussion_points: Discuss long-standing itchy plaques and whether biopsy is needed for uncertain or changing lesions.
